scope: Slice 17 contributor validation; no merge, deployment, learned-model or confidential-casework acceptance

focused.note: Optional integration prerequisite absent; includes entity, notebook, branding and backup regressions.

recognition.limits: Synthetic positive fixtures and one negative prose fixture; not general NER recall or real-case accuracy. Unlabeled scripts without capitalization, single-token names, contextual aliases and unlisted organizations remain limited.

checks: Two synthetic originals uploaded and searchable without a model
Visible empty state and keyboard creation of a person with an alias
Two exact source passages attached to one identity and both reopened from its detail page
Another same-name person remains distinct, with no automatic alias merge
Shared-edit conflict preserves the submitted name and aliases alongside the current saved identity
Return link retains the source-review search context
Discovery processes an inventoried unit without a model and shows remaining uninventoried sources honestly
Reviewer confirms a candidate merge and undoes it without losing the extracted mention
Discovery and reconciliation reflow at 390 pixels with native labeled controls

full_source_restore: Stopped application backup restored into an absent target; original runtime and backup moved offline; restored exact original bytes, source support, extraction coverage, merge history and undo verified; bundle and purge exercised.
compose: Standard, Kerberos and dedicated local-account graphs passed
publication: Working-tree sanitizer passed; outgoing-history scan required before push

full_application.acceptance: Not passed. Exact node equality is diagnostic only; final-head hosted Linux CI is required.
full_application.checkpoint: Full suite preceded two additional concurrency/provider-output tests and small reconciliation/source-validation follow-ups; final entity follow-up passed 24 tests.

limitations: Extraction consumes sealed slice-12 inventories; uninventoried sources remain visibly unprocessed.
Up to 10 units per UI action; 1000 proposals per unit is a fail-closed output ceiling.
No automatic identity merging. Merge retains the emptied original entity for inspection and undo.
Undo refuses later shared edits; this is guarded single-operation undo.
Original passage excerpts retain the 6000-character limit; occurrence offsets refer to the full original unit.
No relationship/event extraction, matter memory, capacity expansion, held Mac work or deployment.
